body:
Final release proof, 2026-06-16:
- GitHub release workflow run 27637689848 succeeded from main commit 6167cfc: https://github.com/telepathdata/7thsense-pqueue/actions/runs/27637689848
- Release gate ran in GitHub clean checkout and passed TP-002 E0-E3, pqueue-core line/branch coverage, pqueue-service line coverage, build-closure verification, release-scale product_validation_tests, and strict product ledger verification.
- Release v0.1.0 exists: https://github.com/telepathdata/7thsense-pqueue/releases/tag/v0.1.0
- Binary assets are published: pqueue-0.1.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz, pqueue-0.1.0-aarch64-linux.tar.gz, SHA256SUMS.
- Supported validated backend profiles: postgres_native and object_log_sqlite_projection.
- ddx doc stale reports all documents up to date.
- gh pr list --state open returns [].
- git status --short --branch is clean on main tracking origin/main before tracker close.
summary: Final release proof passed in GitHub Actions
